newsitem.title: FRANCE: France, Lebanon agree investment protection pact.
newsitem.headline: France, Lebanon agree investment protection pact.

text.p: French Finance Minister and acting Lebanese finance minister Fouad Siniora signed an agreement on Thursday on reciprocal the protection of investments in both countries, a French finance ministry statement said.
The ministry said the agreement allowed for equal treatment in both countries of investments, whether foreign or domestic, and limited the possibilities for expropriation.
It will apply for 10 years after ratification and also cover for a further 15 years any investments made during this time.

The agreement also covers freedom of transfer of investments and the possibility of international arbitration in cases where an investor is at odds with the authorities of the host nation, the ministry said.
